CHK_ENG_2026.title: AICTE Approval Process Handbook Checklist - Engineering & Technology

items.title: Clear Land Title Deed / 30-Year Registered Lease
items.description: Clear title deed registered with sub-registrar or 30-year unencumbered lease with local municipal conversion.

items.title: University Affiliation Letter / NOC
items.description: Valid provisional or permanent affiliation letter issued by the designated affiliating state/central university.

items.title: Approved Building Plan with Competent Authority Sign-off
items.description: Building layout sanctions certified by Town & Country Planning / Municipal Corporation / DTCP.

items.title: Fire & Life Safety Certificate
items.description: NOC from State Disaster Response and Fire Services Department with active validity period.

items.title: Cadre Ratio and Faculty Roster
items.description: Complete faculty list signed by the Principal with PhD/PG details conforming to AICTE cadre ratios.

items.title: Barrier-Free Built Environment & PwD Facilities
items.description: Architect certificate validating ramps, lifts, and accessible restrooms for persons with disabilities.

items.title: Bank Guarantee / Joint Fixed Deposit
items.description: Joint FDR in the name of Regional Officer, AICTE and Chairman/Secretary of the applicant trust.

CHK_MGMT_2026.title: AICTE Approval Process Handbook Checklist - Management Studies

items.title: Land Title Deed / Unencumbered Possession
items.description: Registered deed establishing undisputed possession of designated academic plot.

items.title: University Affiliation / State NOC
items.description: State Higher Education Department NOC and University affiliation approval.

items.title: Sanctioned Master Plan & Built-up Area
items.description: Approved architectural master plan detailing classrooms, seminar halls, and computer center.

items.title: Fire Safety Certificate
items.description: Valid municipal fire department compliance certificate.

items.title: Core Faculty Roster with Cadre Ratio
items.description: List of core and visiting faculty compliant with AICTE norms.

CHK_PHARM_2026.title: AICTE Approval Process Handbook Checklist - Pharmacy

items.title: Land Title and Continuous Campus Deed
items.description: Deed showing contiguous land without public thoroughfare.

items.title: Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) Endorsement
items.description: Letter of permission or standard inspection report from PCI.

items.title: Pharmaceutics & Chemistry Lab Inventory
items.description: Detailed equipment inventory verifying pharmaceutical machine rooms and analysis apparatus.

items.title: Fire and Hazard Safety NOC
items.description: Safety clearance specifically verifying chemical storage ventilation and emergency showers.
